problem_statement: Build a brand-new /orders page from scratch for the AdityaKumawat97 react e-commerce site. The route /orders does not exist yet (blank in baseline). Construct an order-history page that reuses the site's design system (Open Sans Condensed heading style, black/white button treatment, geometric page background, centered max-width column). The page shows a title 'My Orders', a short intro paragraph, a row of order-status filter tabs (All / Processing / Delivered / Cancelled), a section heading, and a grid of order cards (order id, status badge, item name, date/qty/price). The tabs are a REAL interaction: clicking a status tab filters the visible order cards and swaps the section heading (e.g. 'All Orders' -> 'Processing Orders'). The active tab is visually highlighted. Make each tab a <button> carrying a unique data-tab attribute (data-tab="all|processing|delivered|cancelled"). The page must be mobile-clean with no horizontal overflow (cards collapse to a single column under 800px).
required_content: Page title 'My Orders' in an h1
Intro paragraph starting 'Track and review' describing the order history
Four order-status filter tabs as buttons: All, Processing, Delivered, Cancelled
Each tab button carries a unique data-tab attribute (all/processing/delivered/cancelled)
A section heading h3 that reads 'All Orders' by default
A grid of order cards, each with an order id, a status badge, an item name, and a date/qty/price line
Clicking the Processing tab filters cards to Processing orders and swaps the h3 to 'Processing Orders'
Active tab is highlighted (filled black) and the layout collapses to one column on mobile with no horizontal overflow
design_constraints: Reuse the site palette: black (#000) / white (#fff) buttons, dark-grey divider borders
Reuse heading scale (h1 ~38px like existing .title) and Open Sans Condensed body font from App.css
Center the content in a max-width column consistent with checkout/collection pages
No new fonts, no external network assets; plain CSS only (repo uses plain CSS + styled-components)
author_notes: 方案A: baseline 无 /orders (App.js Switch 无匹配且无 catch-all -> 空). reference 完整实现订单页含 status tabs 交互. bad 从 reference 复制但把 activeTab 冻结为 'all' 且移除 button 的 onClick -> tabs inert, 点击 Processing 后 h3 不切换 'Processing Orders' -> interaction_assertion 失败, 而 dom/overflow 仍过. 三份 md5 互不相同 (baseline 无 orders 文件; reference vs bad 的 orders.component.jsx 不同). TOOLCHAIN FIX: 原 repo 是 CRA 2.1.8 + node-sass 4.14.1, Node22 无法编译 node-sass. 已将 3 个 .scss (collection/checkout/sign-in) 转成等价 .css 并从 package.json 删除 node-sass, 三份工作区一致. build 用 NODE_OPTIONS=--openssl-legacy-provider.
